objective: Al terminar cuentas lo que hiciste en el pasado: dónde estabas, qué hiciste y qué no hiciste, y lo ordenas en una historia.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint de la unidad: junta was / were, el pasado regular e irregular, didn't, Did…? y los conectores.

input.recap_es: Repasa: was / were, expresiones de tiempo (yesterday, last night, ago), verbos regulares (-ed), irregulares (went, saw, bought…), didn't y Did…?, y first / then / finally.

explanation.md_es:
**Repaso de la unidad 1**

- *I was at home. They weren't ill. Were you there?*
- *yesterday · last week · two days ago*
- Regulares: *visited, studied, stopped*
- Irregulares: *went, had, saw, bought, ate, met, came, wrote*
- *I didn't go. · Did you see it? — Yes, I did.*
- *First, … Then … After that, … Finally, …*

exercises.prompt: They ___ in Paris last year. (to be)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Con they se usa were.

exercises.prompt: We ___ (go) to the beach last summer.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Pasado irregular de go.

exercises.prompt: ___ they stay at home on Sunday?

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Pregunta: Did + sujeto + base.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: Yesterday I buyed a new bag.
answer: Yesterday I bought a new bag.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Buy es irregular: bought.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: Did you went to school yesterday?
answer: Did you go to school yesterday?

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Después de did va el verbo base.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Después de did va el verbo base.

exercises.audio_text: Last night I didn't cook. I ordered a pizza and watched a film with my sister.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'I ordered a pizza'.

exercises.prompt: Ayer no fui al trabajo porque estaba enferma.
answer: I didn't go to work yesterday because I was ill.
Yesterday I didn't go to work because I was ill.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Negativa con didn't + go; was ill para el estado.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Negativa con didn't + go; was ill para el estado.

exercises.prompt: Escribe 5 frases sobre lo que hiciste el fin de semana pasado. Usa al menos un verbo regular, uno irregular y una negativa.
exercises.model_answer: Last weekend I visited my aunt. We cooked lunch and ate together. I didn't go out in the evening. I watched a film at home. It was great.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.

exercises.situation_es: Un amigo te pregunta por tu fin de semana.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: What did you do last weekend?

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: Did you go out on Saturday night?

turns.speaker: You
choices: No, I didn't. I stayed at home.
turns.why_es: Respuesta corta con didn't y luego pasado.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
